Identifying the concrete SQL INSERT method that executes when a memo is saved.

The INSERT occurs during memo creation, not updates. Three candidate methods were found across the SQLite, Postgres, and MySQL drivers. The default driver is SQLite, so `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`'s `CreateMemo` method executes the INSERT. This was determined by checking the default driver configuration in `cmd/memos/main.go`.

The full call chain is now traced. `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` delegates to `Store.CreateMemo`, which invokes the driver's `CreateMemo`. For the default SQLite driver, this resolves to `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:42`, where the INSERT is executed via `QueryRowContext`.

The exact insertion line is `QueryRowContext` within `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:42`. The determination method is tracing the default driver assignment in `cmd/memos/main.go` through `store/db/db.go`'s `NewDBDriver` switch.

I am identifying which concrete method executes the SQL INSERT when a memo is saved, and how to determine the active candidate among multiple possibilities.

I am distinguishing INSERT from UPDATE and excluding non-user-flow paths such as seed data or migrations. I am also checking whether CreateMemoComment delegates to CreateMemo.

Beginning to enumerate the three candidate methods for memo INSERT.

Three candidates were identified: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`, `(*postgres.DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, and `(*mysql.DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/mysql/memo.go`. The default driver is sqlite. The call chain for saving a new memo is `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` → `Store.CreateMemo` → `driver.CreateMemo` via interface dispatch. `UpdateMemo` issues UPDATE instead of INSERT, so it does not apply to new saves.

The INSERT is executed by `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` at line 42. This was determined by tracing the startup flow: `cmd/memos/main.go` sets the default driver to "sqlite", `store/db/db.go` instantiates `sqlite.NewDB`, and `store/memo.go` delegates `CreateMemo` to the active driver. Only one driver implementation is instantiated at startup, so the same method handles the INSERT.

h12.
`(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`; traced the save path from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`APIV1Service.CreateMemo` → `Store.CreateMemo` in `store/memo.go` → `store.Driver.CreateMemo`), then ruled out the other INSERT implementations (`store/db/postgres/memo.go`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go`) because a default install sets `--driver`/`driver` to `"sqlite"` in `cmd/memos/main.go` (lines 122 and 130) and `store/db/db.go` `NewDBDriver` selects `sqlite.NewDB` only for that driver at startup.

The INSERT itself is built and executed inside `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` via `d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, stmt, args...)` (line 42), with the `INSERT INTO memo (...)` statement assembled on line 41. Updating an existing memo goes through `UpdateMemo`, which runs an `UPDATE`, not an `INSERT`.
